1.t: When the Sky is cleft asunder;

3.t: When the Oceans are suffered to burst forth;

4.t: And when the Graves are turned upside down;-

5.t: (Then) shall each soul know what it hath sent forward and (what it hath) kept back.

6.t: O man! What has seduced thee from thy Lord Most Beneficent?-

7.t: Him Who created thee. Fashioned thee in due proportion, and gave thee a just bias;

8.t: In whatever Form He wills, does He put thee together.

9.t: Nay! But ye do reject Right and Judgment!

10.t: But verily over you (are appointed angels) to protect you,-

11.t: Kind and honourable,- Writing down (your deeds):

12.t: They know (and understand) all that ye do.

13.t: As for the Righteous, they will be in bliss;

14.t: And the Wicked - they will be in the Fire,

15.t: Which they will enter on the Day of Judgment,

16.t: And they will not be able to keep away therefrom.

17.t: And what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?

18.t: Again, what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?

19.t: (It will be) the Day when no soul shall have power (to do) aught for another: For the command, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allah.
